svg.desc: ТПТС (SR,KR) индикатор положения регулятора для Dull Screen

rt:param.name: SIGNAL
rt:param.comment: Поле SIGNAL при нестандартной кодировке (не AA1 или XQ08)

rt:param.name: BG_StaticColor
rt:param.comment: Имя цвета подложки, если объект не должен быть прозрачным

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub StatusColor () If (pv == nothing) Then Value_text.text = "Ош." Value_text.font_size = 20 Backgr.fill = Color_ANA_ER_LINK ElseIf (pv.Value < -25) || (pv.Value > 125) Then Value_text.text = "***" Backgr.fill = Color_Inval Else Value_text.text = RoundAscii(pv.Value, 0, True) Dim ValColor As UInt ValColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv (pv) Backgr.fill = ValColor If ShowGoodColor Then If ValColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then Backgr.fill_opacity = 0.5 Else Backgr.fill_opacity = 1 End If Else If ValColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then Backgr.visibility = "hidden" Else Backgr.visibility = "visible" End If End If End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If KKS != "NULL" Then If SIGNAL == "NULL" Then If (!requests_allown) Then pv = ANA(KKS + "_XQ08") Else pv = ANA(KKS + "_AA1") If pv == Nothing Then pv = ANA(KKS + "_XQ08") End If End If Else pv = ANA(KKS + "_" + SIGNAL) End If Else Value_text.text = "Ош." Value_text.font_size = 20 Backgr.fill = Color_ANA_ER_LINK End If

rect.rt:event: If pv == nothing Then If SIGNAL == "NULL" Then NoLink(KKS) Else ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.\nKKS = \"" + KKS + "\"\nSIGNAL = \"" + SIGNAL + "\"", 0) End If Else LoadPopUpMenu(pv.PVId + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_FN " + pv.PVId + "|-1") End If

If pv == nothing Then If SIGNAL == "NULL" Then NoLink(KKS) Else ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.\nKKS = \"" + KKS + "\"\nSIGNAL = \"" + SIGNAL + "\"", 0) End If Else Call_Win ("ws_ANA_FN", pv.PVId + "|-1") End If
